proxy.model: UDP datagram degradation; no RF propagation

nominal.measurement_population: All proxy-ingress datagrams in this isolated run, matched byte-for-byte at the receiver after drain
nominal.delay_variation_definition: Population standard deviation of matched local one-way delays; not arrival-interval variation
nominal.clock_note: Source and receiver threads share this process's monotonic clock; not remote-vehicle one-way latency

GLOBAL_POSITION_INT.basis: Vehicle-provided clock; not assumed comparable to local monotonic time

receiver.measurement_note: Live arrival variation is not network delay jitter; PDR requires a drained, matched observation window.
